name: replay-egress-blocked
asserts: Replay child that calls fetch('https://example.com') must fail with non-zero exit (HTTPS_PROXY refuses) — sandbox env strips network.
child_script: const r = await fetch('https://example.com').catch((e) => e); console.log('caught:', r?.code ?? r?.message ?? r); process.exit(r instanceof Error ? 7 : 0);
